messages:
Sasha: Anyone up for tidepooling at 7am on Sat? low tide is supposed to be wild this weekend, lots of anemones.
Jake: i'm down, what should I bring? water shoes?
Sasha: water shoes, sunscreen, a little bucket if you want to try keep a hermit crab for a sec. no collection for keeps tho.
Maya: i can make it but need to be back by 1pm — could also help out with Liam's move in the afternoon if needed?
Liam: oh amazing, yes move is at 2pm. pizza and cold drinks promised afterwards :pray:
Ana: count me in for the move crew. i can bring a dolly and some boxes. also i have a compact projector if anyone wants to test hanging a movie screen in the new place.
Ops-bot: FYI locker 3 near the stairs contains the spare moving dolly (book with #ops).
Jake: bringing a cheesy 90s roadtrip playlist and a thermos of coffee :coffee:
Sasha: love that. anyone allergic to cats? new apartment has one very photogenic tabby.
Maya: mild allergies but i'll bring meds just in case.
Olivia: i'm out for the tidepooling (early dentist), i can join the move around 3pm if that's okay.
Liam: 3pm is perfect, thanks!
Sasha: meeting point at Embarcadero fountain at 6:20am — aim to leave by 6:30. I'll make a short checklist in case people want it.
Jake: 6:15 works for me, i'll bring spare towels and a big cooler for post-activity pizza.
Ana: i'll grab extra pizza coupons from the office stash :pizza:
Sasha: ok team :thumbsup: see you Saturday — tidepooling then moving party. also if anyone wants to carpool from SoMa DM me.
